name.description:
Name for this instance of {@link Action.Requirement}. The name of an Action.Requirement consists of the following parts:
{@link Action.Requirement#runtime runtime}, {@link Action.Engine#languageVersion language version}, {@link Action.Requirement#location location}, and {@link Action.Requirement#executor executor}.
All parts except for {@link Action.Requirement#runtime runtime} are optional.
A test action requirement will end with suffix "-test" and {@link Action.Requirement#engine engine} of a test action requirement is always a test action engine, which can run tests.
This method will return null if there is no valid {@link Action.Requirement#engine engine} for this instance of {@link Action.Requirement}.
For example, the Action.Requirement "py-ml-server" has:
 - runtime: py-ml
 - location: SERVER
 - executor: None

title:
An instance of {@link Action.Requirement} represents the minimum requirements set by a user to execute an {@link Action action}. The most important elements of an instance of {@link Action.Requirement}  are
the {@link Action.Requirement#runtime runtime}, the {@link Action.Engine#languageVersion language version}, the {@link Action.Requirement#location location}, and the {@link Action.Requirement#executor executor}.
name: Action.Requirement
